Privacy

Visitor analytics.

Simple, aggregate statistics about where readers visit from.

Information collected

This site can count page loads and add them to daily totals for approximate country, city, and network provider. These are grouped summaries rather than individual visitor records. Repeat visits count again.

Cloudflare processes the connection’s IP address to provide approximate location and network information. The custom analytics database does not store IP addresses, visitor identifiers, browser fingerprints, page URLs, referrers, user agents, or exact visit times. Approximate locations can be inaccurate, particularly with VPNs and mobile networks.

Purpose and retention

The statistics are used only to understand the readership of this research portfolio. Daily counters expire after 89 days. The dashboard is private and password-protected. These numbers represent page loads, not unique people.

Cookies and browser storage

The custom counter uses no cookies or browser storage. If browser or network protections block the request, the visit is simply not counted.
